name: No !@#$s Left to Give
source:
No !@#$s Left to Give is a short abstract visual novel about what you feel about having too many or too little !@#$s left to give.

[From [url=https://knickknackpj.itch.io/no-censoreds-left-to-give]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的抽象视觉小说，探讨你觉得自己还有多少“!@#$”可以付出，或是剩下太多、太少时的感受。

[来源：[url=https://knickknackpj.itch.io/no-censoreds-left-to-give]Itch.io[/url]]
